items.title: Thanksgiving Food Drive
items.body:
Every year, we come together to support those in need and help make Thanksgiving a little brighter for individuals and families. We are proud to continue this tradition by providing Thanksgiving meals to those who may need a helping hand, extending our support beyond our immediate community.

We are excited to announce that our 2026 Thanksgiving Food Drive will run from October 25 through November 15, 2026!

Your support, generosity, and kindness can make a meaningful difference in someone’s life this holiday season. Together, we can help ensure that more individuals and families have a warm meal and a reason to be thankful.

Let’s spread kindness, share blessings, and make this Thanksgiving special for everyone. Every contribution counts!

Thank you for supporting our mission and helping us make a difference, one meal at a time.

items.title: Saint Jude Novena
items.body:
Join Us for the Saint Jude Novena | October 20–28

This year, during our Saint Jude Novena, we will reflect on the seven virtues; good habits that guide us in choosing what is right, growing in holiness, and becoming more Christ-like in our daily lives.

These virtues shape our thoughts, guide our actions, and influence how we respond to God and to one another.

May this novena be a blessed time of prayer, reflection, and spiritual growth as we deepen our faith, strengthen our relationship with Christ, and seek the intercession of Saint Jude.

items.title: Communications Updates
items.body:
Parish Email & Website Update We are pleased to announce that our parish has officially migrated to the @saintmaronphilly.org email domain, and our new parish website is www.saintmaronphilly.org.

Going forward, all official parish communications will be sent from this domain, including emails from:

pator@saintmaronphilly.org office@saintmaronphilly.org SMOC@saintmaronphilly.org, ccd@saintmaronphilly.org myo@saintmaronphilly.org mya@saintmaronphilly.org.

If you are not receiving parish emails, please check your spam or junk folder and mark our emails as “Safe” or “Trusted Sender” to ensure future messages reach your inbox.

We encourage everyone to save our new website and email addresses in their contacts.
